content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the server incorrectly requiring a "Content-Length" header when the "Transfer-Encoding" was set to "chunked". According to the HTTP/1.1 specification, when using chunked transfer encoding, the "Content-Length" header should not be included, as the data is sent in a series of chunks. The patch corrects this by checking for the "Transfer-Encoding" header and ensuring that if it is set to "chunked", the "Content-Length" header is not requested or processed, thus preventing a bad request response when both headers are present.
